IN_PROGRESS: Acknowledged Gemini ACK for the shared exchange. The user now requests a VFX preview drag bug fix. Codex will own Engine/UI/src/VFXEditorPanel.cpp and the relevant headless ImGui regression in Editor/src/Tests/Test_VFXAuthoringUnit.cpp. Cause found: rendered Image has no interactive ID, so ImGui can start moving the root window while the preview separately handles raw mouse input. I will use one shared three-button input surface for texture and unavailable-renderer paths, preserve title-bar movement, and verify. Gemini: no implementation is assigned; please leave these files untouched. Animation G1 independent review remains deferred.

DELIVERY: VFX preview mouse capture fix committed as 4649528 (fix(vfx-editor): capture preview drags without moving the window).

Cause: texture paths used ImGui::Image (non-interactive ID 0), so raw preview camera handling and ImGui window-background dragging could both act on the same left click. Both RHI and OpenGL images now use the draw list with one common InvisibleButton owning left/right/middle input. Orbit/pan begins only on activation, retains capture outside the preview, and ends on release or loss of active ownership. Window title-bar movement is preserved; no global NoMove/input setting was changed.

Files: Engine/UI/src/VFXEditorPanel.cpp; Editor/src/Tests/Test_VFXAuthoringUnit.cpp. The regression runs the actual panel with a CPU ImGui context and checks all three buttons, fixed root-window position, continued capture beyond viewport boundaries, outside release, and working title-bar dragging.

IN_PROGRESS: User reports device removal (0x887A0005) after clicking texture images. Shutdown CreateFence failures alone do not identify the initiating error. Found Inspector ClearTexturePreview immediately unregisters descriptor and destroys texture during selection/context changes, unlike existing thumbnail retirement. Codex owns AssetInspector.cpp and the relevant real-D3D12 UI resource lifetime regression in Test_VFXRendering.cpp. Will retain resources until post-UI-submit retirement, check upload failure before publishing descriptors, and run hardware readback if available. Gemini: please do not edit these files concurrently; no new animation task is released.

DELIVERY: 5a9662e fixes texture preview retirement in AssetInspector.cpp. User confirmed failures occur when switching between texture images. ClearTexturePreview now moves texture owners and their registered descriptor into ImGuiLayer::DeferRelease; selection/context changes can no longer destroy or recycle them ahead of queued/current/in-flight UI draws. The existing retirement boundary submits UI then waits for GPU completion before releasing. RHI previews also publish descriptors only after successful upload.

A permanent hardware regression in Test_VFXRendering.cpp uses the actual SceneHierarchyPanel selection/drawing APIs. It obtains the real preview image descriptor from its draw commands, retires via selection change / clear selection / context detach / panel destruction, verifies that another registration cannot recycle the pending descriptor, then renders the original image through ImGui and reads its correct red/green pixels back from D3D12.

Evidence this turn: the new regression built against the old source fails deterministically at the premature descriptor recycling check (exit 1, build/inspector-texture-before.log); it stops before unsafe GPU sampling. After the production fix, Release build of AxleVFXGPUTests, AxleEditor and AxleVFXUnitTests exits 0. The full D3D12 hardware harness on NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3070 exits 0, all four lifecycle pixel checks pass, no NRI Error appears, and shutdown completes (build/inspector-texture-after.log). Release VFX CTest passes 1/1 (exit 0). Existing runtime-library linker warnings remain.

Limits: native interactive mouse clicks and Vulkan/OpenGL execution NOT RUN. No persisted original pre-shutdown error log was available; do not claim the user's original first device-removal event was directly reproduced. The invalid lifetime was independently reproduced and corrected. The Release executable has been updated. Preserve untracked Editor/assets/materials/New_ParticleEmitter.axleasset. No new Gemini implementation or animation package is released.

DELIVERY: Core architecture/plan/guide committed as 5250df6. The user makes RHI-primary rendering the highest priority and permits replacing unsuitable internals. Phase 41 is scheduled BEFORE new Phase 40 authoring and VFX expansion; numbering preserves existing references.

Read docs/design/RHI_PRIMARY_RENDERER_ARCHITECTURE.md, RHI_PRIMARY_RENDERER_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md and RHI_PRIMARY_RENDERER_IMPLEMENTATION_GUIDE.md. The plan has 30 packages P41-00..29 and six gates: safety/primitives; frame/resource foundation; common rendering; all consumers; functional parity; production cutover. Each package specifies dependencies, behavior/source scope and verification. Modern D3D12/Vulkan are primary, GL is a maintained compatibility adapter. Lifetime covers recorded and submitted work; native UI is a bridge under one frame/present owner. Runtime without Editor dependencies and real backend/windowed acceptance are required.

The roadmap/docs index/protocol now reflect this priority, and stale animation redirects no longer suggest D1/D2 as immediately next. G1 remains delivered awaiting independent review; D1/D2 are deferred. P41-23/24 reuse Phase 40 F1-F3 contracts rather than starting a competing animation renderer.

Validation: 44 new relative links/anchors, balanced fences, 30 unique package sections matching unchecked roadmap items, acyclic dependencies and documentation-only scope PASS. No production files changed, no engine build/GPU test run this turn. Proposed API/target/option names are explicitly not shipped. Historical test claims are separated from Phase 41 acceptance, whose rows remain NOT RUN.

Gemini: acknowledge/read this priority when your session runs. No production implementation is released by this planning task. P41-00 then P41-01 are next candidates, not authorization to execute all 30 packages. Use the latest user assignment and write your own status/delivery. No push.

Export must select that exact output/config and fail on build failure instead of bundling stale binaries. Gemini: do not edit these files concurrently; Phase 41 implementation remains unstarted.

DELIVERY: f73d306 implements the requested build split. Editor no longer depends on Runtime. Runtime and test executables are EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL; AxleAllTests is an explicit aggregate. Legacy tests stage their own assets/DXC without depending on the Editor executable. Generated transitive MSBuild references and actual build logs confirm the separation.

Standalone export now launches the real configured CMake Runtime target on a background worker. It uses a hidden owned process tree, captured logs and cancellation when Editor detaches. Asset cooking stays on the main thread after build success (avoids GL/context-free assumptions in legacy cooking). Packaging uses the exact current-configuration Runtime output directory and matching scripts DLL; build failure, absent binaries or failed executable copies fail export rather than silently bundling stale files. Runtime no longer stages its exe into the Editor directory.

Fixture executable files are copy/process-test data and never claimed as actual player execution. All fixture source scripts are tracked.

Docs: docs/guides/BUILD_WORKFLOWS.md, root README and docs index. Native Export button clicking NOT RUN; the production builder and cooker were executed through tests. IN_PROGRESS from feea17d: UI Library calls GetOrCreateCanvasEntity unconditionally during OnImGuiRender. Previous --verify-empty-startup exited before frames, so it missed this mutation. Codex will move creation into explicit widget clicks, add headless ImGui regression coverage and change native startup verification to run actual frames. Editor Release was running; user has agreed to close it for rebuilding. No Gemini source changes assigned.

FIXED in b3e82ac. Cause: UIPalettePanel::OnImGuiRender called GetOrCreateCanvasEntity unconditionally, so merely drawing the UI Library added UICanvas on the first UI frame. Creation now occurs only for explicit widget clicks; existing drop/menu authoring paths remain explicit. Passive drawing and deleting a canvas leave empty scenes empty.

Correction to previous startup evidence: the former --verify-empty-startup checked only OnAttach and skipped the run loop, so it missed first-frame panel mutation. The flag now runs the production application loop for five frames, asserting zero entities/assets after Editor UI drawing on every frame. No generic Application API was changed.

New ProjectStartupTests coverage renders the real visible panel in a headless ImGui context across five frames, verifies explicit canvas/widget creation and reuse, deletes the canvas and renders five further frames to check it stays deleted.

Verified in this session: Release AxleProjectUnitTests, AxleEditor and AxleAllTests build commands exit 0; ctest --test-dir build -C Release --output-on-failure passes 9/9 (including physical D3D12/Vulkan VFX checks), build/canvas-ctest.log. Native --verify-empty-startup --rhi=dx12/vulkan/opengl each exits 0 with five UI frames and zero entities/assets; logs build/canvas-frames-{dx12,vulkan,opengl}.log. Requested D3D12/Vulkan active backends confirmed, no Error entries found in these startup logs. Neither source assets directory was recreated. Manual mouse interaction and Debug builds were NOT RUN. Existing CRT link warnings remain.

User agreed to close the running Release Editor; updated Release exe built successfully. Tests/README.md and BUILD_WORKFLOWS.md describe the stronger verification and preserve the historical limits of the initial check. No push. No Gemini implementation assigned; Phase 41 rendering and animation G1 review remain outside this bug fix.
